calls.statement:
SELECT 
  dp.category,
  dd.fiscal_year,
  dd.fiscal_period,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_period = 8
  AND dd.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY dp.category, dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period
ORDER BY dp.category, dd.fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
  dd.fiscal_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  MIN(fsl.net_amount) AS min_line_amount,
  MAX(fsl.net_amount) AS max_line_amount
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_period = 8
  AND dd.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_year DESC

calls.statement:
WITH period_8_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    dd.fiscal_year,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_period = 8
    AND dd.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY dp.category, dd.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  category,
  (SELECT net_sales FROM period_8_sales p2 WHERE p2.category = p1.category AND p2.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25') AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
  (SELECT net_sales FROM period_8_sales p3 WHERE p3.category = p1.category AND p3.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26') AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(((SELECT net_sales FROM period_8_sales p4 WHERE p4.category = p1.category AND p4.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26') - 
         (SELECT net_sales FROM period_8_sales p5 WHERE p5.category = p1.category AND p5.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25')) / 
        (SELECT net_sales FROM period_8_sales p6 WHERE p6.category = p1.category AND p6.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25') * 100, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM period_8_sales p1
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY category

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  (39146.83 - 59501.02) / 59501.02 * 100 AS garden_growth_raw,
  ROUND((39146.83 - 59501.02) / 59501.02 * 100, 2) AS garden_growth_rounded

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN fsl.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN fsl.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN fsl.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
          SUM(CASE WHEN dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN fsl.net_amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
         SUM(CASE WHEN dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN fsl.net_amount ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS growth_percent
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_period = 8
  AND dd.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category
